lines.zh: 影子在树后走，没有声音
lines.en: A shape walks behind the trees, soundless.
You can't quite follow my path.
No prints left on the pine needles.
I shift position with every step.
That leg in the mist is mine.

lines.zh: 你转头的瞬间，我移动了
lines.en: While you turned, I moved.
I walk pressed to the trunks.

lines.zh: 远处的轮廓，一会儿就没了
lines.en: The distant outline fades in a moment.
I circle you without closing in.

lines.zh: 夜里的松林，回声是我的
lines.en: That echo in the pines is mine.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，光会暗一点
lines.en: The light dims a little where I pass.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步，却找不到我
lines.en: You hear steps and find nothing.
I stand, and you doubt yourself.
That's what I'm for.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃饭，只需要你看我
lines.en: I don't need food; only your eyes.
How many times have you blinked?
The shadows sway, and so do you.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓很清楚，可没人相信
lines.en: My outline is clear, but no one believes.
The detector ticks, and it isn't me.
I count how often you look back.

lines.zh: 这林子里，真实的只有你
lines.en: In this forest, only you are real.
I breathe, and you don't hear it.

lines.zh: 我存在过吗，你也说不清
lines.en: Did I exist? Even you can't say.
The wind stops; I remain.
The surer you are, the blurrier I get.
I live in the corner of your eye.
Don't stare too long.
Are you sure that was me?
There's a layer of mist between us.
Counting my eyes?
My outline is shifting.
Your torchlight doesn't reach me.
One stands behind you too.

lines.zh: 我不是真的，也不全是假的
lines.en: I'm not real, but not wholly false.
One step closer, and I thin out.
Don't shout; no one answers.
Your face says disbelief.
I'm here until you stop looking.
Close your eyes; I remain.
I'm under that pine.
Did you bring the detector?
Its ticking means I'm here.
You hit nothing, yet felt it.
I scattered, then gathered.

lines.zh: 你确定刚才是我挨的打吗
lines.en: Are you sure I was the one hit?
The mist closed again.
I withdrew; my outline faded.
Even the pain is false.
Your hand is shaking.
I'm still here; don't celebrate.

lines.zh: 打散我，需要的不只是力气
lines.en: It takes more than force to scatter me.
The harder you strike, the clearer I get.

lines.zh: 你拿着的东西，我看不上
lines.en: I have no use for what you hold.

lines.zh: 你举着它，是想安抚自己
lines.en: You hold it to comfort yourself.
That won't buy you peace.

lines.zh: 你可以放下，我不会靠近
lines.en: Set it down; I won't approach.

lines.zh: 诱饵对我没用，我不是野兽
lines.en: Bait won't work; I'm no beast.
That light is too weak.
You're still trying to play by rules.
There are no rules in this forest.
Put it away; you'll see better.
You hit the air.

lines.zh: 刚才那个位置，我已经不在了
lines.en: I'm no longer where I was.
Touching me means you're too close.

lines.zh: 这个碰撞，你确定发生过吗
lines.en: Are you sure that happened?
I backed off, and you didn't see.
That chill on your shoulder was me.
The mist thickened; you hit a tree.

lines.zh: 我只是轮廓，撞不出声音
lines.en: I'm only outline; no sound comes from me.
I need no kin.

lines.zh: 你连我是什么都不知道
lines.en: You don't even know what I am.

lines.zh: 这种事，发生在别的地方
lines.en: Such things happen elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我只是你脑子里的东西
lines.en: I'm only something in your head.
Would you partner with a hallucination?
Even my touch is false.
You should sober up.
When the mist clears, I'm gone.
Ask yourself that.
I wasn't bred.
I don't pick that up.
It's yours, not mine.

lines.zh: 我碰不到它，你看到了吗
lines.en: I can't touch it; see?
Did it just move?

lines.zh: 你在捡一个不存在的东西
lines.en: You're picking up something that isn't there.
Are there footprints there?

lines.zh: 我弯腰的样子，你也看到了
lines.en: You saw me bend too.
I didn't put that there.
Your hand is empty.
Look down: what's left in your hand?
You're starting to fear.

lines.zh: 这时候，我才算真的出现
lines.en: Now I'm truly here.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我的轮廓越清楚。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the sharper my outline gets.

lines.zh: 我不用靠近，你就够受了
lines.en: I needn't approach to hurt you.
You looked back; I'm ahead.
I won't chase; I'll wait for you to run.
I've already stood where you're running.

lines.zh: 你听见的第二声脚步，不是你的
lines.en: The second footstep isn't yours.

lines.zh: 林子在帮你，还是在帮我
lines.en: Is the forest helping you or me?
Do you remember the way in?

lines.zh: 你听见的第三声脚步，是我。
lines.en: The third footstep you hear is mine.
The light flickers; it's time.

lines.zh: 你带了探测器，它现在很安静
lines.en: Your detector is quiet now.
Quiet is worse than ticking.
I'm here, always have been.
You can't hide anymore.
I follow, neither near nor far.

lines.zh: 你每走十步，就回头一次
lines.en: Every ten steps, you look back.
Behind that pine: me again.
I'm on the path ahead.

lines.zh: 雾把我的位置藏得很好
lines.en: The mist hides my position well.
Your torch is dying.
If you cannot see me clearly, good.
You don't dare stop.
And I don't intend to let you.
Did you walk the way I did?
The forest is silent, except for you.
How long until dawn?
The sky never changes color.
I'm inside your shadow.
Look back and you'll see me.
Or don't; same result.
You've been circling already.

lines.zh: 你感觉到一记，却没有伤口
lines.en: You felt a blow, with no wound.
My fingers are cold.

lines.zh: 你被推倒了，推你的东西不在
lines.en: You were pushed by nothing.
That touch on your neck was me.
The crack you heard was your own.
You can't prove this one.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的领口，你摸不到手。
lines.en: I grip your collar, yet your hand finds nothing.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，但我够得着
lines.en: You can't see me, but I reach you.
You fell into the pine needles.
The wound will show up later.
I leave no traces.

lines.zh: 你开始怀疑自己没有受伤
lines.en: You start doubting you were hurt.
This time you heard it.

lines.zh: 幻影贴在你耳边，听你换气。
lines.en: The hallucination leans in and hears you breathe.

lines.zh: 我只是阴影，阴影也会压人
lines.en: I'm only shadow, and shadow can crush.
The mist thickens first.
An outline appears among the tree shadows.
You feel watched.
I come from nowhere you can find.
The pine forest is unnaturally quiet.
The detector starts ticking.
Footsteps, but no prints.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是看到什么
lines.en: Did you just see something?
I stand at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 这个林子里不止你一个
lines.en: You're not alone in this forest.

lines.zh: 你听见远处的树枝折断
lines.en: You hear a branch break far off.
I appeared, or maybe not.
There are eyes in the mist.
Your torch can't find me.
I chose this place.
Turn around.
I'm in that direction.
Don't trust the detector.

lines.zh: 火光里，我的影子更长了
lines.en: In the firelight, my shadow grows longer.

lines.zh: 我落下去了，但没有声音
lines.en: I fell, and made no sound.
I don't breathe; I can't drown.

lines.zh: 爆炸把雾吹散，我也淡了
lines.en: The blast blew the mist apart, and I faded.
The arrow passed through; I didn't fall.
This magic can see me.

lines.zh: 饥饿对我没有任何意义
lines.en: I don't need to eat.

lines.zh: 雷光把林子照亮，我无处藏
lines.en: Lightning lit the woods; nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有了，连我也在掉
lines.en: Nothing below; even I am falling.
